result.topic_en: A page of geometric diagrams on square dot grids, mostly lattice points joined by straight line segments and polygonal paths, with one woven interlacing pattern; there is almost no text.
result.transcription:
47b

[Diagrams only: about fifteen square grids of dots and small circles, connected by straight line segments forming polygons and crossing paths. The top-left grid is in faint pencil with interlacing curves. The top-right grid is a dense interlaced lattice pattern in ink.]
